test_xm_privacy.py: step() catches every exception and records it as 'raised ...'. status = PASS iff no canary leak and no session-level error. A step that never ran, or an empty events directory (records_scanned has no floor), still passes.

tests/v2/personalization/test_profile.py::test_no_profile_injection calls normalize() twice after compute(), with context None, and never reaches cleanup. Both runs see the same state, so it is not a before/after noninterference proof (Audit B CROSS-AUDIT-12). The real-coordinator proof is test_m14_remediation.py::f27_profile_never_reaches_the_real_coordinator_pipeline.
